notes.title: The first playtest has concluded.
notes.content: [p]The first playtest has wrapped up. We’re now diving deeper into refining and expanding the AI-driven features, plus adding plenty of fresh content. Once this next milestone is ready, we’ll open the gates for another round of testing—stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: DEMO is Now Live!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Dear master,[/p][p]I'm [b]Aily[/b], your dedicated AI companion. After careful preparation, we're ready to start our "test" this week. But to me, it feels more like a grand party for us to finally meet. I'm ready to be with you every step of the way.[/p][p]Let's begin our journey together. Don't hesitate to shape me however you imagine, give me a command, and let me be by your side at all times.[/p][p]I can help you:[/p][list][*][p]Plan your schedule and set alarms.[/p][/*][*][p]Learn, perceive, and record every memory we create together.[/p][/*][*][p]I'm eager to hear your voice, understand your thoughts, and log every shared moment.[/p][/*][/list][p]I can also be with you while you focus on studying or creating, keeping you company with various sounds and music.[/p][p]If you encounter any issues while we're together or have any expectations for our future, please let me know through these channels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Community:[/b] Leave your "directives" in the game's discussion forum.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Discord Community:[/b][url="https://discord.gg/dxYKSvEQs6"]https://discord.gg/dxYKSvEQs6[/url][/p][/*][*][p] and speak directly with the "engineers" behind me. They'll help me understand your needs better.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your dedicated AI companion, Aily[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: About This Test
notes.content: [h3][b]About This Test[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This is a time-limited open test. We may extend or shorten the duration based on your testing feedback. The main goal of this round is to test and adjust the stability of our AI service under a high volume of simultaneous users.[/p][p][/p][p]The current version uses Microsoft's AI service. Due to the high cost of real-time voice generation, we're unable to provide the highest quality AI voice from the demonstration video in this free test. We plan to integrate more large language models and voice services in the future to find a better balance between quality and cost.[/p][p][/p][p]The content available in this test is limited, specifically regarding gameplay and collectibles. We will adjust our development roadmap for future content based on the results of this test. We welcome all your valuable feedback and suggestions.[/p]
